system.description:
Clan Trait

Mutated Trait: Uzumaki Sealing Techniques

Beginning at character creation, select one jutsu of B-Rank or lower that you qualify for, adding this jutsu to your known list, but with some key differences. This jutsu now becomes your Original Technique. A jutsu that is unique to you and you alone. This version is one that only you can utilize to its fullest potential.

Its cost is set as Special (An amount equal to its rank: D-Rank: 5, C-Rank: 9, B-Rank: 14, A-Rank: 20, S-Rank: 25)

Its base rank is set as Special (The Highest Rank you can cast, based on your level), and can only be cast at its base rank.

If it deals damage, reduce the amount of damage dice it has by an amount equal to its rank. As its rank grows based on your level (bullet point 2) return half the reduced damage dice rounded down for each rank. Once its base rank matches its original rank, it loses the damage dice penalty. (D-Rank: 0, C-Rank: -2, B-Rank: -4)

It gains the Hijutsu keyword.

Beginning at character creation, you can select 2 effects from the Jutsu Creation System (See Chapter 7: Adventuring & Missions, Learning/Creating A Jutsu), from the section that has a matching jutsu discipline as your select Jutsu (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu/Bukijutsu), and adding them to your chosen jutsu. You can select 1 additional effect at 7th and 15th levels.

You cannot select the same effect more than once.

You cannot select the following effects; Lasting, Upcast, Damage, Empowered Damage, Multiple Strikes, Damage Reduction, Augmentation, Unavoidable or Mind Control.

Work with your GM on how these modifications make this selected jutsu function in the narrative. GM’s have final say over if an effect is compatible with your selected Jutsu.

If you take this mutation, you must also take any one 1st, 3rd, 11th and 15th level Uzumaki mutation.
